def model_ram_gb(params: float, bits: int) -> float:
    """RAM (in GB) to run a model: params x bytes/weight x 1.2 overhead."""
    bytes_per_weight = bits / 8
    weight_bytes = params * bytes_per_weight
    total_bytes = weight_bytes * 1.2
    return round(total_bytes / 1e9, 2)

print(model_ram_gb(7e9, 4))
